messages:
ravi: kicking off design note: we should consolidate fast admit checks into a tiny "probe" layer that returns a compact decision and a reproducible repro_cmd. goal: surface catastrophic failures in ~2-4m and hand off to micro-bench or quarantine.

anya: +1. need explicit contract: input -> {artifact_id, hw_profile, run_mode}. output -> {decision_enum, reasons[], repro_cmd, report_url (optional)}. decision_enum = FAST_PASS | PROBATION | QUARANTINE.

samir: probe should cover: tokenizer parity, kv roundtrip, short-anchor top1-signature, and p95 perf smoke. keep sample = stratified 3 buckets (S/M/L) + optional rare-edge.

ravi: sampling policy: default weights S:60 M:30 L:10. rare-edge runs only on weekly rotation or when metadata.flagged_multilingual=true.

anya: for top1 signature, compute per-position topK indices and hash them into a compact signature. compare Hamming and topK-Jaccard to avoid float nondet issues.

samir: impl note: use k=5 and seed everything. if top1-stability < 90% or top5-jaccard < 0.85 -> PROBATION. if tokenizer diff > 0 or kv mismatch -> QUARANTINE.

ops-bot: infra: probe-image pushed -> gcr.io/redwood/probe:v1.2 digest sha256:fa7b... scheduled rollout 2026-04-05.

lex: UX ask: repro_cmd should be one-line that runs a debug container, e.g. `./probe --artifact 0xdead --case=long --seed=42`. console button should copy it.

ravi: agree. also attach minimal run metadata: runner_image, gpu_type, exact tokenizer hash, seed, and bucket mapping. make those visible in report_url.

anya: enterprise/private: support offline-run mode where probe returns a signed-attestation blob instead of uploading report_url. attestation = {run_id, decision, runner_digest, signature}. registry can verify later.

samir: adapter deprecation: remove adapter-legacy in 45d but add compatibility shim that returns HTTP 410 + migration_link. also publish a migration CLI to convert old calls to new contract.

ravi: operational flow: sync probe in preflight for fast-fail (<30s) covering tokenizer+kv; if PASS then enqueue async probe (2-4m). async result drives micro-bench or quarantine. if PROBATION -> route to 0.1% canary for 24h.

lex: telemetry: emit probe_latency_ms, p95_ms, token_diff_count, top1_pct, top5_jaccard, runner_digest, and seed. tie metrics to model id and admit-run id.

anya: golden rotation: rotate one anchor per bucket weekly; keep rotation PRs and signed manifests. background replay compares last 4 rotations; drift > thresholds -> create regression ticket.

samir: thresholds: top1 drop > 6% or token diffs increase by > 3 are auto-high. big drops -> immediate quarantine. small drops -> PROBATION and canary.

ops-bot: alerting rule created: SLO probe async median < 5m, 99th < 8m. alert if QUARANTINE rate > 2% day-over-day.

ravi: next steps: I'll draft the OpenAPI for /probe-sync and /probe-async, the attestation schema, and a short playbook for quarantine. @anya @samir please review; i'll sprint a PR this week. :rocket:
